# Hounsfield Lab

> A directory of open-source and downloadable software for medical AI development, curated by a practicing neuroradiologist. Radiology-first, plus pathology, clinical NLP and EHR tooling. 46 tools. Repository data snapshot: 2026-10-13.

Badges: LIC = license (license files reviewed by hand where GitHub could not detect them); UPD = last repository push (UTC); STATUS = Maintained if updated within 12 months of the snapshot, else Stale; COMM = Permissive, Copyleft (GPL/AGPL), Non-commercial, or Verify (custom terms or separate model-weight terms). Not legal or medical advice.

## Pages

- [Directory](https://hounsfieldlab.com/directory.html): filterable list of all tools
- [Pipeline guide](https://hounsfieldlab.com/pipeline-orthanc-mercure.html): Orthanc → mercure → TotalSegmentator → OHIF
- [About](https://hounsfieldlab.com/about.html): curation method
- [Full catalog for LLMs](https://hounsfieldlab.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Catalog JSON](https://hounsfieldlab.com/data/catalog.json)

## Foundation models & agents

### Pillar-0 (finetune code + HF weights)
- What it does: Open 3D radiology foundation model; finetuning framework, weights on Hugging Face
- Type: Foundation model
- Modality/specialty: Radiology: CT (chest, abd-pelvis, head), breast MRI
- Maintainer: YalaLab
- License: ECL-2.0
- Commercial use: Permissive
- License note: Repo LICENSE is Educational Community License 2.0 (Apache 2.0 with a narrowed patent grant). Hugging Face weights (Pillar0-ChestCT, -AbdomenCT, -HeadCT, -BreastMRI) are tagged ecl-2.0.
- Last repository update: 2026-10-12 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/YalaLab/pillar-finetune, https://huggingface.co/collections/YalaLab/pillar-0
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/pillar-0.html

### Pillar-0 pretraining
- What it does: Vision-language pretraining code for Pillar-0
- Type: Foundation model
- Modality/specialty: Radiology CT/MRI
- Maintainer: YalaLab
- License: ECL-2.0
- Commercial use: Permissive
- License note: Repo LICENSE is Educational Community License 2.0.
- Last repository update: 2026-01-13 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/YalaLab/pillar-pretrain
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/pillar-0-pretraining.html

### RATE
- What it does: Uses an LLM (Qwen3 via sglang) to extract structured labels for 366 findings from radiology reports
- Type: Evaluation / report labeling
- Modality/specialty: Radiology reports
- Maintainer: YalaLab
- License: ECL-2.0
- Commercial use: Permissive
- License note: Repo LICENSE is Educational Community License 2.0.
- Last repository update: 2026-05-20 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/YalaLab/rate
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/rate.html

### Merlin
- What it does: 3D vision-language model for CT that uses structured EHR and report supervision
- Type: Foundation model
- Modality/specialty: Radiology: CT
- Maintainer: Stanford MIMI
- License: MIT
- Commercial use: Permissive
- Last repository update: 2026-09-24 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/StanfordMIMI/Merlin
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/merlin.html

### MedGemma
- What it does: Google's open medical model family; repo has notebooks and code
- Type: Foundation model
- Modality/specialty: Multimodal medical (imaging + text)
- Maintainer: Google Health
- License: Apache-2.0 (code)
- Commercial use: Verify
- License note: Code is Apache-2.0. Weights on Hugging Face are under the Health AI Developer Foundations terms: https://developers.google.com/health-ai-developer-foundations/terms
- Last repository update: 2026-06-19 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/Google-Health/medgemma
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/medgemma.html

### CheXagent
- What it does: Foundation model for chest X-ray interpretation
- Type: Foundation model
- Modality/specialty: Radiology: chest X-ray
- Maintainer: Stanford AIMI
- License: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
- Commercial use: Non-commercial
- License note: Repo LICENSE is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0.
- Last repository update: 2025-01-07 (Stale)
- Links: https://github.com/Stanford-AIMI/CheXagent
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/chexagent.html

### MedRAX
- What it does: Reasoning agent for chest X-rays that orchestrates multiple CXR models (ICML 2025)
- Type: Agent
- Modality/specialty: Radiology: chest X-ray
- Maintainer: Bo Wang Lab
- License: Apache-2.0
- Commercial use: Permissive
- Last repository update: 2025-10-31 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/bowang-lab/MedRAX
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/medrax.html

### LLaVA-Med
- What it does: Biomedical vision-language assistant for image Q&A
- Type: Vision-language model
- Modality/specialty: Biomedical multimodal
- Maintainer: Microsoft
- License: Microsoft Research License
- Commercial use: Verify
- License note: Repo LICENSE is the Microsoft Research License Terms, covering code, models and data. Read the terms before any use beyond research.
- Last repository update: 2025-06-04 (Stale)
- Links: https://github.com/microsoft/LLaVA-Med
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/llava-med.html

## Segmentation & frameworks

### MONAI
- What it does: PyTorch-based AI toolkit for healthcare imaging
- Type: Framework
- Modality/specialty: Medical imaging (all)
- Maintainer: Project MONAI (NVIDIA + academic)
- License: Apache-2.0
- Commercial use: Permissive
- Last repository update: 2026-10-13 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/Project-MONAI/MONAI
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/monai.html

### MONAI Label
- What it does: AI-assisted image labeling and active learning; integrates with 3D Slicer and OHIF
- Type: Annotation
- Modality/specialty: Medical imaging
- Maintainer: Project MONAI
- License: Apache-2.0
- Commercial use: Permissive
- Last repository update: 2026-10-12 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/Project-MONAI/MONAILabel
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/monai-label.html

### nnU-Net
- What it does: Self-configuring segmentation framework
- Type: Segmentation
- Modality/specialty: Medical imaging (all)
- Maintainer: DKFZ (MIC)
- License: Apache-2.0
- Commercial use: Permissive
- Last repository update: 2026-10-13 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/nnUNet
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/nnu-net.html

### TotalSegmentator
- What it does: Segments more than 100 anatomical structures in CT and MR
- Type: Segmentation
- Modality/specialty: Radiology: CT/MR
- Maintainer: J. Wasserthal
- License: Apache-2.0
- Commercial use: Permissive
- Last repository update: 2026-10-06 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/totalsegmentator.html

### MedSAM
- What it does: Segment Anything adapted for medical images
- Type: Segmentation
- Modality/specialty: Medical imaging (2D)
- Maintainer: Bo Wang Lab
- License: Apache-2.0
- Commercial use: Permissive
- Last repository update: 2025-05-07 (Stale)
- Links: https://github.com/bowang-lab/MedSAM
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/medsam.html

### MedSAM2
- What it does: Promptable segmentation of 3D medical images and videos
- Type: Segmentation
- Modality/specialty: 3D imaging and video
- Maintainer: Bo Wang Lab
- License: Apache-2.0
- Commercial use: Permissive
- Last repository update: 2025-07-11 (Stale)

### TorchIO
- What it does: Medical image loading, preprocessing and augmentation for PyTorch
- Type: Data / preprocessing
- Modality/specialty: Medical imaging (3D)
- Maintainer: TorchIO project
- License: Apache-2.0
- Commercial use: Permissive
- Last repository update: 2026-10-06 (Maintained)

### PyRadiomics

## DICOM/PACS & deployment

### pydicom
- What it does: Read, modify and write DICOM files in Python
- Type: DICOM infrastructure
- Modality/specialty: DICOM
- Maintainer: pydicom
- License: MIT (+ noted portions)
- Commercial use: Permissive
- License note: Repo LICENSE is MIT except for portions listed in the file.
- Last repository update: 2026-10-13 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/pydicom/pydicom
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/pydicom.html

### DCMTK
- What it does: Comprehensive set of DICOM libraries and tools (C++)
- Type: DICOM infrastructure
- Modality/specialty: DICOM
- Maintainer: OFFIS
- License: BSD-3-Clause (OFFIS)
- Commercial use: Permissive
- License note: COPYRIGHT file is a BSD-style license from OFFIS e.V.; some bundled parts carry other notices.
- Last repository update: 2026-10-10 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/DCMTK/dcmtk
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/dcmtk.html

### Orthanc
- What it does: Lightweight DICOM server; this repo builds the Docker images and installers
- Type: PACS / DICOM server
- Modality/specialty: DICOM
- Maintainer: Orthanc team
- License: AGPL-3.0
- Commercial use: Copyleft
- Last repository update: 2026-09-28 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/orthanc-server/orthanc-builder
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/orthanc.html

### mercure
- What it does: DICOM orchestrator that routes studies to AI processing pipelines
- Type: AI deployment / orchestration
- Modality/specialty: DICOM routing
- Maintainer: mercure (NYU origin)
- License: MIT
- Commercial use: Permissive
- Last repository update: 2026-10-07 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/mercure-imaging/mercure
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/mercure.html

### Kaapana
- What it does: Platform toolkit for medical imaging AI (federated, workflows)
- Type: AI platform
- Modality/specialty: Radiology
- Maintainer: DKFZ
- License: AGPL-3.0
- Commercial use: Copyleft
- Last repository update: 2026-10-13 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/kaapana/kaapana

- Modality/specialty: Digital pathology (WSI)
- Maintainer: TIA Centre, Warwick
- License: BSD-3-Clause
- Commercial use: Verify
- License note: Code is BSD 3-clause. LICENSE says the model weights are under a different license (see TIAToolbox pretrained-model docs).
- Last repository update: 2026-10-12 (Maintained)
- Links: https://github.com/TissueImageAnalytics/tiatoolbox
- Page: https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/tiatoolbox.html
